usage: policy for repo containing languages not covered by approved SAST
name: All languages should be covered by SAST
description: The approved SAST (Static Application Security Testing) application should scan all code files regardless of language.
detailedDescription: SAST (Static Application Security Testing) applications are the most basic type of security vulnerability detection applications that an organization should use. From SQL injections to cross-site scripting SAST applications are a basic requirement to stop easily preventable issues from making their way to production.

args.name: scanType
args.label: Scan Type
args.tooltip: Choose one or more static security engines to generate the policy for.
